scheme_name: Market Support Scheme for Smaller Business Units
other_conditions: The unit (new or existing) must have its operations located in Goa.
The applicant must be a Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership as defined under the relevant Indian Acts.
The bank account(s) of the unit and/or its partner(s)/director(s) must be linked to Aadhaar.
Pre‑approval from the Empowered Committee is required before attending an exhibition to claim reimbursement.
Application must be submitted at least 60 days prior to the exhibition date.
benefits_summary: Provides 50% reimbursement of exhibition rental cost up to 9 sq m for national/international exhibitions, subject to pre‑approval.
